summary: MapKit covers embedded map views, annotations and overlays, search, geocoding, directions, Look Around and snapshots. gaps: No map view or map tile rendering in the SDK or renderer, so no app can show a map
No annotations, overlays or selectable map features
Reverse geocoding is city level only: no street address or placemark parts (sdk core_location::reverse_geocode; shell springboard/src/shell/services/location.rs:287)
No points-of-interest search, nearby search or search completion beyond city and place text search
No SDK routing API: directions exist only inside the maps app (springboard/apps/maps-desktop/src/route.rs, an OSRM-compatible server or a straight-line estimate)
No renderer composes a static map image: map_snapshot models the tiles, pins and zoom, but there is no tile source
No maps URL handling or default navigation app
IMDF parsing missing (GeoJSON is parsed: springboard/core/src/geojson.rs, springboard/ui/src/map_geojson.rs)
